title: short in length
text:
short in length. These hangers are a little less than 2 inches shorter than the average plastic hanger. So be aware if you're wanting to hang adult clothing. It will be ok for women's t-shirts, tanks, but not for men's clothing. I cover the hangers with yarn so that clothing is less likely to slip. I am just disappointed these are signficantly shorter than the standard plastic hanger.
I think they would be good for people with small closet space as the hooks are compact and the width of the plastic rod is small too. Hope this helps!

features: Sturdy construction, holds shirts, coats, folded pants
Multiple Hanging options, small Accessories bar & lingerie hooks
description: Honey-Can-Do HNGZ01521 60-Pack Recycled Plastic Tubular Hangers, Blue. A versatile, lightweight (34g) clothes hanger, perfect for polos, t-shirts, and tank tops in a 60-piece value pack. The large rod hook is designed to fit over any closet bar. Integrated accessory hooks keep garments with spaghetti straps in place, plus hang scarves or belts nicely. A big help in the laundry room, these hangers are great for air-drying delicates. Recycled plastic construction is an alternative.
